supersedes: the 60 multi-camera clips in claude-draft-1.json, which were drafted by the padding rule without looking at the clip
drafted_by: Claude (Sonnet 5.5), from zoomed contact sheets: for each view the part of the picture with the most movement, cropped and enlarged, one frame every 2 s; the most active view of each clip (two when the first was quiet)
how_to_read: stages are [phase, from_s, to_s] in seconds into the clip. confidence: seen = the activity was visible; hint = part of it was, or something that fits it; prior = nothing of it could be picked out. how: zoomed frames = read from the zoomed sheets; padding rule = looked at, nothing found, so baseline for the first 10 s, action until 10 s before the end, aftermath after. People are small in these views and the sheets are 2 s apart: expect to correct most of them. Drafts for a person to correct, not labels; use `annotation-kit draft-edits` to say how much was changed.
